candidates.statement: Checkout 502s stem from downstream latency: traces show order and payment calls failing with transport ReadTimeout (~2s), while inventory/redis succeed. Gateway /v1/checkout p95 is ~2406ms, matching the ~2s timeouts, so the gateway returns 502.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show timeouts on both order and payment; which downstream is the primary latency source is not isolated. No dependency-level metrics returned.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout returns repeated 502s with ~2s durations. Traces show order and payment calls erroring with transport ReadTimeout while inventory/redis succeed; checkout p95 ~2406ms aligns with the timeouts. Bounded candidate is downstream latency. Dependency-level metrics were empty, so the specific slow dependency is not isolated.
